blocks.text: American rock sensation Sleep Theory is finally bringing their explosive sound to the Philippines as they embark on their first-ever Manila show on February 18, 2027, at Skydome, SM North EDSA, as part of their 2027 Headline Tour, presented by PULP Live World! Hailing from Memphis, Tennessee, Sleep Theory has quickly established itself as one of the most exciting breakout acts in modern heavy music. Composed of Cullen Moore (vocals), Paolo Vergara (bass, vocals), Daniel Pruitt (guitar, vocals), and Benjamin Pruitt (drums, vocals), the band is known for its distinctive fusion of passionate R&B, hard-hitting rock, and infectious pop sensibilities.
